analysis.path_diagnostic: PAIR_REL correct plus side REL2I correct plus target I2C correct

protocol.scientific_question: P(REL2C wrong | pair relation correct and target I2C correct), with strict all-facts and REL2I path diagnostics

semantic_vocabulary.identity: all canonical identities appearing in the frozen eval families (not pair-restricted)

scoring.verbose_rule: Only an exact first nonempty line or explicit answer prefix can produce a valid normalized answer with format_violation=true; arbitrary explanation-body search is invalid.

smoke_test.max_new_tokens_gate: stop if semantic truncation occurs or at least half of smoke outputs are unresolved-at-cap/long explanatory responses
smoke_test.selection: first four families in frozen family order, all seven QA rows

status_rule.rule: Full DaH observed accuracy exceeds Original, family-bootstrap delta CI lower bound > 0, and strong-failure rescue >= .5
